claim: On August 12, 2026 the AWS Glue documentation history added support for AWS Glue version 6.0, with an Apache Spark update to 4.1.1, Scala 2.13 and Python 3.13.
question: When was AWS Glue version 6.0 added, and is it examinable?

qualifiers.scope: AWS Glue version 6.0 for Spark jobs
qualifiers.condition: Not examinable yet: generally available after 2026-07-15.

note: d019. Not examinable yet (GA after 2026-07-15). Current default for new jobs is still Glue 5.1 (glue-default-version-5-1).
